title: Change is the Only Absolute
summary: This paper introduces a discrete, piece-wise cyclic state function, f(Cycle) = S(Events), governing a six-stage cosmic lifecycle driven by the foundational absolute that change must change. By formalizing a non-spatial, zero-volume boundary phase-change designated as the Point of Peace (Su2081), this framework eliminates the infinite density singularities of General Relativity and bridges the ideological worldviews of theism, agnosticism, and atheism into a strict mathematical equality (x) during the active timeline.We challenge the traditional paradigm of linear background time,…

review.reason: Presents a discrete cyclic state function for cosmic lifecycle and time, with philosophical framing.
